jobs.title: Software Engineer - AiDP Reliability Engineering, IS&T, Early Career Opportunities (200677645-0157)

jobs.title: 2027 | Americas | Dallas Metro Area | Engineering | New Analyst (171568)
jobs.assessment: Goldman Sachs 官方 2027 Dallas Engineering New Analyst Program，明确面向 final-year undergraduate/graduate students，属于真正的 2027 NG 岗。Engineering 涵盖大规模软件系统、big data、machine learning 与 financial engineering。岗位比 181810 更宽泛，不保证分到 AI/ML 团队，但品牌、工程平台和 New Grad 适配度都很高。Qien 已投 181810；Goldman 每个 recruiting year 最多允许申请 4 个 business/location combinations，因此该岗位值得作为另一独立申请认真考虑。
jobs.visa: 官方该页面未明确 sponsorship；申请前/流程中确认
